sentences.text: Bombus terrestris was reported 728 times in the Mainz-Bingen region over the past ten years, with a main time from February to September and the most reports in June and July.
Flower visits are recorded for Greater Knapweed, Creeping Thistle and White Clover.
Further flower visits have been observed at Heather, Oregano and field scabious.
Flower visits are also recorded at Himalayan balsam and common dandelion.
